params.body:
The npm advisory gate in `tests` went red on #1040 with 7 high advisories against a ceiling of 6. The new one is vite: GitHub published six advisories for vite 8.3.0 to 8.3.2 (GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw, GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22, GHSA-vfpm-58rq-9qcg, and three in launch-editor: GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw, GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm). All of them concern the dev server, not the built assets, but the gate counts them. Main was green on 20 October and would go red on its next run.

- `vite` from 8.3.0 to 8.3.4 (`^8.3.4` in package.json). 8.3.4 is two weeks old; 8.3.5 came out yesterday and is not taken yet.
- The lock file loses sass, terser and @parcel/watcher. They were optional peer dependencies of vite, and nothing here uses them: there are no .scss files and no terser setting.
- One sentence in the comment above the audit job in tests.yml.

Locally: `npm ci`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:js` (103 passed); `npm-audit-ceiling.mjs 6` gives 6. The remaining six are the known braces chain under Tailwind 3 and vite-plugin-static-copy.
params.title: Move vite to 8.3.4: six new advisories on 8.3.0 to 8.3.2
